method.crypto: Top 150 coins by size, minus stablecoins, wrapped/staked copies and memecoins; market cap over $1B; liquid; not in free fall. Ranked on strength against Bitcoin over 200 and 30 days (55%), smallness (15%), distance below the all-time high (15%), liquidity (10%), calm last week (5%); coins that are already vertical lose points.
method.stocks: Nifty 500 stocks with market cap ₹2,000-80,000 cr, tradable (₹3 cr+ a day), profitable with a P/E under 100, return on equity 12%+ (or, where Yahoo has no figure, a 8%+ profit margin), modest debt, earnings and revenue growing 10%+ (growth capped at 100% so one-off jumps don't dominate), above the 200-day average, up over six months and within 30% of the 52-week high. Ranked on growth (30%), momentum (25%), quality (20%), growth-adjusted valuation (15%) and smallness (10%).
